pages.text: The Waste Reprocessor makes nuclear waste safe. It turns each Depleted Fuel Rod into a harmless block of $(l:nuclear/vitrified_waste)Vitrified Waste$(/l), and sometimes recovers uranium and a rare $(l:nuclear/isotope_shard)Isotope Shard$(/l).

It needs a $(l)Cyber Frame on top$(). Right-click the machine alone and a drone shows where. Once complete, its plate grows up a block with a plaque on it. It does not work until then; breaking the frame folds it back.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: The plaque marks it as a machine that handles radioactive material. It stands a little above the block: leave the space over it free to see it.

$(li)$(l:nuclear/radiation)Depleted Fuel Rod$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/vitrified_waste)Vitrified Waste$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/uranium)Uranium Ingot$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/isotope_shard)Isotope Shard$(/l)$(br)$(li)Put $(l:nuclear/radiation)Depleted Fuel Rods$(/l) in. Waste waiting inside the Reprocessor is $(l)shielded$(): it does not contaminate.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Automate it$(): a hopper under a $(l)Reactor Port$() pulls Depleted Fuel Rods out of the reactor, and a hopper into the Reprocessor feeds them in. Hoppers below take the products out.$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) plug in on its front, sides or back.

$(li)It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.$(br)While it works its disc turns a quarter at each quarter of the batch: the rod waits on the left, melts at the top, leaves as glass on the right, and the pocket comes round empty at the bottom.

$(li)$(l)Time$(): 10 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Energy$(): 160 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Always$(): 1 $(l:nuclear/vitrified_waste)Vitrified Waste$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l)1 time in 3$(): 1 Uranium Ingot$(br)$(li)$(l)1 time in 4$(): 1 $(l:nuclear/isotope_shard)Isotope Shard$(/l)
